sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "appearances"."player_id" AS e, "player"."throws" AS g, SUM("appearances"."g_dh") AS m1 FROM "appearances" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "appearances"."player_id"  GROUP BY "appearances"."player_id", "player"."throws"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of games as designated hitter per player within player.throws (additive)
share of the all total of total of games as designated hitter (all level)
rank within the group by total of games as designated hitter, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "batting"."player_id" AS e, "player"."throws" AS g, AVG("batting"."so") AS m1 FROM "batting" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "batting"."player_id"  GROUP BY "batting"."player_id", "player"."throws"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of strikeouts per player within player.throws
gap to the all average of average of strikeouts (all level)
rank within the group by average of strikeouts, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "all_star"."player_id" AS e, "player"."death_country" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "all_star" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "all_star"."player_id"  GROUP BY "all_star"."player_id", "player"."death_country"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: gap to the all average of number of all_star records (all level)
